description: A measurement case for the agent-only benchmark mode (Requirement 22 AC2). SessionTable is clean for every deterministic Source: it is encrypted, has point-in-time recovery, carries the required tags and a retain policy, and the template declares no IAM resource or policy document, so no deterministic detector and no bundled Guard rule fires. The expectation under measurement lives in expected_findings_agent_only: a BestPractice observation that only agent reasoning reaches -- that a session table with no TimeToLiveSpecification grows without bound, an Availability concern no single-resource rule expresses. It is supplied by a fixed agent-finding fixture (benchmark/agent-findings/case-201-agent-only-oversized-policy.json), never generated during the run, so the benchmark stays deterministic. This entry declares an expected_remediation so the Remediation Accuracy diagnostic reports a value, and the case declares an expected_human_intervention_count so the Human Intervention Count diagnostic reports a value.

expected_findings_agent_only.note: The session table declares no TimeToLiveSpecification, so expired sessions are never removed and the table grows without bound. Reachable only by agent reasoning, not by any deterministic rule.
